reasoning_content: Web is on two networks. Let me get the IP on the ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default network specifically.

action.command:
WEBIP=$(docker inspect -f '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks "ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default").IPAddress}}' ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web); echo "WEBIP=$WEBIP"
docker run --rm --user 1000:1000 -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e \
  --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default --add-host web:$WEBIP \
  -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web \
  -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password \
  cypress/included:latest run --spec "cypress/e2e/02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js" 2>&1 | tail -60; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "WEBIP=$(docker inspect -f '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks \"ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default\").IPAddress}}' ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web); echo \"WEBIP=$WEBIP\"\ndocker run --rm --user 1000:1000 -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e \\\n  --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default --add-host web:$WEBIP \\\n  -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web \\\n  -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password \\\n  cypress/included:latest run --spec \"cypress/e2e/02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js\" 2>&1 | tail -60; echo \"EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Run cypress directly on ddev network"}
